Ok lots of varied ideas on this.

First we will go with cleaning. Just average cleaning use a can of air. Make sure that you spray it so the liquid doesn't come out. That will freeze and if your bricks are under stress they will crack.

Now once a year I disassemble all of our lego and wash them in Luke warm water. This isn't required but the newer bricks are not as strong in the clutch power (lego bonds) as old ones. I lay the set out on a towel and let the pieces dry then rebuild.

That brings me to storage of books. I use a file cabinet with the hanging drop in file holders. Grouped by theme. So its easier to find.

Now display.

Ok we have a metric shitload of lego so display is well by theme. Some are hanging from fishing line. I use 10lb from screw in hooks on the rafters of my basement.

Lots of people use Ikea but I used the large outdoor tables. I have 4 six ft long ones and a massive picnic table. Then for smaller stuff we have three multi shelves. They have four platforms and are only two ft long for each.
